reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star

I had a very disappointing and frustrating experience at this animal hospital. I brought my dog in because he was panting excessively, trembling, crying, and showing signs of distress. I was extremely worried about his condition.

I waited approximately four hours, and during that entire time, no veterinarian examined my dog. The staff could not even tell me when the doctor would arrive.

After waiting so long without receiving any medical attention, I requested a refund so I could take my dog somewhere else. They refunded my money, but only because I asked for it.

What upset me the most was not the money, but the fact that my dog was suffering while we waited for hours without any answers.

Pets are family, and when we bring them to an emergency animal hospital, we expect compassion, communication, and timely medical attention.

I would never bring my dog back to this hospital. This was an extremely disappointing experience.
We came in the other night with our cat who has some stomach issues and they treated us so well. I felt very reassured and I felt that our little girl was in good hands!

This is a first class, emergency location as well as regular animal care location.  super professional high-end services great people they’ve handled everything from euthanasia of animals for us to emergency visits for us and regular care first class and I can’t emphasize that enough. This is the most perfect veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to.

I have struggled with whether to write this review, but I feel other pet owners deserve to know about our experience.

We boarded both of our dogs at this facility. Within five days of being picked up, both of our dogs were dead.

While one of our dogs was 13 years old and specifically boarded here due to their ability to house her as a "level 1 ICU patient" I do think the timing was unfortunate. She was sedated during her entire stay which seemed excessive but I trust it was necessary for her comfort. Our other dog was 7 years of age and  had no known illness prior to her stay and, notably, had also been in this facility’s care just one month earlier. Following this most recent boarding stay, however, both dogs became seriously ill after coming home. The circumstances surrounding what happened to them were devastating and deeply concerning to our family.

I want to be careful not to state that the facility caused their deaths, because I cannot prove that. What I can state with certainty is that two dogs from the same household were boarded here together, were picked up from the facility, and both died within five days of leaving its care.

Losing one dog would have been heartbreaking. Losing both of our dogs within days of bringing them home from the same boarding stay is something our family will never get over.

When you leave your animals with a boarding facility, you are placing an enormous amount of trust in the people caring for them. Based on what happened to our family, I could never entrust another pet of mine to this facility, and I believe prospective clients should know about our experience before deciding whether to leave their animals here.

I wish this place treated humans because I would go here. It’s nicer than any hospital or doctors office that I have ever been to. Really, it is a top notch facility. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Don’t expect a discount though. You get what you pay for. This place must know how good they are because they really charge you for it

They are some of the nicest and most knowledgeable vets I have ever visited. The doctor is saw was honest about what is happening with my elderly dog and how I can make her more comfortable in her last few months. I appreciate their kindness. I will absolutely be using them from now on.
Leaving 2 stars instead of 1 since they are harder to delete. This is truly the most incompetent and useless staff in the world. Someone needs to report this place.
Excellent vets and services
Very Impressed Great Staff Secure Efficient And Did A Great Job Treating My Dog In An Emergency Highly Recommended
Staff is always very kind!
They're bad, you call and if you don't speak English they hang up on you, and I had an emergency with my cat
Great vets, great place to take your pets!

We have been going to this clinic for years but this is the first time we have had to put one of our babies to sleep. The words compassionate care do not even describe the kindness and understanding that was given to us.  It was 4 am in the morning, my 17 year old maltipoo was struggling to breathe due to end stage heart failure and Dr. Nguyen got to the clinic very quickly and helped ease our boy across the rainbow bridge.  She spoke gently and did things so that I had time to say goodbye.  She explained each step of the process and my baby died a gentle peaceful death in my arms. They are the best vets in town and I will be forever grateful to Dr. Nguyen for making a horrible experience somewhat bearable.

This is a great vet. Hands down received the best service here. Dr Cooper is incredibly kind and understanding and what’s more important to me is that they aren’t owned by a private equity firm. Unfortunately these days a lot of other vets are and they drive the costs up much higher.
I would absolutely recommend this place over any other vet. Probably best to check prices before you go.
Keeps us happy

I had a very disappointing experience with Westbury Animal Hospital, specifically regarding a recent boarding stay for my dog. I was significantly overcharged, and when I reached out multiple times for clarification, I did not receive a clear or reasonable explanation of the charges.
What was most concerning, however, was the response I received from Dr. Jeff Chalkley. Instead of addressing my concerns professionally, I was told to"  Stop contacting them and that I—and even my pets—are no longer welcome on their property". This kind of response is not only unprofessional but also dismissive of legitimate customer concerns.As a paying client, I expected transparency, respectful communication, and accountability. Unfortunately, this experience reflected the opposite. I would strongly caution others to carefully review their billing and consider whether this is the level of customer service they are comfortable with. Definetly we will not return since we felt cheated and scammed!
Dr. Cole, Dr. Cooper, and all the staff here took great care of our cats while giving us reasonable updates. Thank you Westbury animal hospital!

I have been going to Westbury for years and have had numerous pets seen there and spent thousands of dollars and yet when I need to get a Pet in on a rush, they can’t fit me in. Also, they need to train their staff to be more compassionate and friendly. I’ve always felt like the staff there are not very friendly.

My puppy has a fractured leg and requires orthopedic surgery. I have been calling around looking for the best price and everyone else has been very helpful. He has already had x-rays and been evaluated by a vet. However, Westbury says they are unable to use and want me to pay for another visit and additional X-rays.
Very poor and incompetent customer service at this location. Especially the receptionist by the name Katherine. She is extremely rude and lacks common sense.

1 start its a lot for this place !
I am writing this with a heavy heart after losing my dog due to what I believe was extreme negligence by this hospital. This wasn’t the first time they failed us, but it was the last.
Two years ago, I brought my dog here with a hernia. The vet’s immediate "solution" was to put him down. I refused, took him to another hospital, and after a simple surgery, he lived happily for two more years.
A few days ago, while I was away, my dog stopped eating and drinking. The pet sitter took him back to Westbury. The vet gave him fluids and unknown medications and saying he have hernia on the other side , but decided to discharge him instead of keeping him for observation or do emergency surgery  , When asked if the dog would be okay until Monday/Tuesday, she explicitly said yes.
Shortly after returning home, my dog began having violent seizures for 9 minutes straight. He passed away the next morning.
I cannot understand why a vet would release a dog in such critical condition without monitoring. If you love your pet and want them to receive logical, professional care, stay away from this place. They lack the judgment needed to save lives.

I brought my baby girl Peepa here in December for an emergency. I won't get into the details but I was crying, I was scared, there was nothing we could do, I lost her. It was one of the worst days of my life.

Westbury Animal Hospital did everything they could for her and for me. They gave us our last moments alone before we let her go. And their commitment to compassionate care made the worst day go the best it could, at a price better than I could've imagined, and handled getting her ashes back to me quickly and with a paw print as well.

I miss her more than anything but you and your team made her last hours comfortable and let me hold her for the last time. I can't thank you enough.

My cat was severely weak, on the verge of dying, really, and their good service and professionalism saved him. He spent three days hospitalized there and after that he came home and, under doctor's indications, the cat has miraculously survived. Even though he was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease and went into the hospital weighing 4.88lb as a result of the previously undiagnosed illness, two months later he is weighing 9.20lb and still alive, most likely thanks to the doctor's great advise and expertise. Their prices are also great when compared to more expensive and not necessarily better places in Sugar Land. Can't recommend it enough! Five years after this, and I am still religiously coming to this veterinary hospital with the same veterinarian. Love this place.
Excellent customer service
The vet team quickly and compassionately provided emergency care.

I am not sure how I haven’t written a review sooner. Dr. Eckermann is the best. He is compassionate, thorough, and takes amazing care of my dog. The staff at Westbury is also incredibly kind and attentive as well. There’s a vet right down the street from me, but I drive the distance to see Dr. Eckermann!

I calling around several animal clinics this morning trying to get their process and pricing for euthanizing our dog.
Of course I know different clinics have different options so I was trying to compare apples to apples here. It is very difficult having to make this decision and having to call people and tell the same thing over and over is hard enough but to have businesses that try to take advantage of us is inexcusable.
I called Westbury Animal Hospital and asked for pricing. She told me $79.50 for an office visit and if we want cremation with urn it would be $200 so the ESTIMATED cost would be $280-$290. I said ok... why is the price an estimation? I don't want to get there and think I am paying roughly $300 and then be surprised by any other fees. She kept repeating the prices above. So I said I just wanted to make sure that the price I will pay is roughly $300. She said she would have to find out... so she comes back to the phone and finally tells me that the total is $550! I was floored! I said wait what?? That is over $200 more than you originally told me...
I said so if i had not asked exact pricing i would have gone in there thinking it was around $300 and then you spring it on me that no sorry now its $550!??
We are already having to deal with this right now and for them to be giving wrong pricing is so unethical! I am so angry right now!!
I mean what do you do at that point?! You get your dog there and have already thought he was going to go and you prepare yourself and your family and then they spring it on you that sorry, we were wrong! Now your price is this! I mean do they think people will just say ok I will pay it?!?!?

This hospital truly cares for their patients. I was a worried dog mom searching for answers and without even stepping foot in the building they gave me clear feedback and addressed my concerns. I can only imagine the care and customer service they would provide if I needed to visit in person.
Dr Chalkley is a highly qualified vet that is good at explaining things and I trust his opinion. He was able to give me 2 options on a difficult situation.
Took the best care of our cats over the years. Wonderful team.

I have taken my pets to Westbury for at least 15 years.  Unfortunately their level of competency, professionalism, and integrity has become dismal. I recently waited an hour beyond my appointment time to see a vet for some routine things and then they couldn’t clean my pup’s ears because she was too anxious.  She was anxious because she was there for an HOUR.  I had a serious issue with another one of my dogs and after billing me $1,500.00 and not giving my dog steroids for a neck injury they sent me Gulf Coast, who immediately gave my dog steroids.  So, I’m done.  Finished.  And I would advise you to find another vet that actually offers “compassionate competent care”.
Great staff, knowledgeable vets, open late, affordable, and a calm atmosphere. Everything you want in a vet.
Extremely rude staff,  couldn't even get past the front,  they are demanding money before even seeing my pet, absolutely no heart and no regard for my pet
Excellent place and very good service for your pet. Highly recommended.

We took our pup here due to an injury. We did have to wait a couple of hours, but it was due to there being more severe injuries that they had to tend to first. I appreciated the fact that they came in frequently to update us on the wait. We spent the majority of our time in the evaluation room, so I didn’t have to stress about being in the waiting room with other pets. My pup was able to relax off leash during that time. We had X-rays and were prescribed medicine. I did pay a $250 deposit that went towards that, and did not have to pay too much more. Everyone seemed very friendly, and again, I really appreciated them constantly updating us on our wait. If we ever need an ER vet again, we will definitely go here. Highly recommend.
So grateful for this hospital and their docs. Couldn’t recommend them more highly.

I’ve consistently received excellent care here for both my dog and my cats. The veterinarians are knowledgeable, compassionate, and always take the time to answer questions. While their prices may not be the lowest in town, they are very fair for the quality of care provided, and the team is always transparent about costs. I’ve had to bring my pets in for both urgent and emergency visits, and each time they were handled with professionalism, clear communication, and a realistic, transparent approach to diagnoses, treatment options, and pricing.
Best Doctors in town

I wanted to share my honest experience in hopes that it brings awareness and encourages improvement within your practice. I truly believe anyone who works with pets should be compassionate and empathetic toward the little four-legged angels who come through your doors—especially in emergencies when families are already stressed and scared.

We brought in our puppy after he injured his paw, trusting that a 24-hour emergency vet would provide both medical care and emotional support. Unfortunately, from the moment we walked in, the front desk felt very cold and disengaged.

A vet tech took our puppy to the back, and about 30 minutes later the doctor came in. The interaction felt very detached—no warmth, no sympathy, and the news given to us was alarming and delivered without any compassion. We were told he needed immediate surgery and would likely lose his leg. Hearing something so serious delivered in such a cold manner was incredibly painful for us as pet parents.

Out of concern, we took our puppy for a second opinion at another veterinary clinic. Not only did the new vet confirm he does not need surgery, but they also pointed out that the cast put on by your team was applied incorrectly. His injury was on his paw, yet the cast extended all the way up to his hip, which the doctor said could potentially affect his growing bones. This was extremely alarming considering your clinic charged us over $600, only for us to leave terrified and with improper care.

My advice—and sincere request—is that moving forward, your team practices more empathy when delivering difficult news. Not everyone is emotionally or financially prepared to hear worst-case scenarios without context, reassurance, or a sense of compassion. A little understanding goes a long way. Additionally, please consider exploring other treatment options before presenting the most severe outcomes as the only possibility.

We love our pets like family, and in emergency situations, we look to you for guidance, clarity, and comfort. I hope this feedback encourages a more thoughtful and supportive approach for future clients.

Thank you for taking the time to read this.
Pretty good but they are very slow with pick up or drop off for boarding regardless of the time of day

Dr. Cooper is the best!
So knowledgeable and personable. He walked us through everything that was going on with our pup and answered all of our questions thoroughly. I feel confident bringing our dogs here for the best care.
Great service and care for our dogs and cats.
Great place to care for you canine, one of the best out there for sure.
Caring staff and clean facility. They treat our pet gently and explain everything clearly. We felt our pet was in good hands.
This place only just wants your money, doesn’t care for your pets. Never again
Took my dog to the vet their prices maybe high and wait times are long depending on the day but the level of care is top notch. Dr. Wynn took great care of us.
They are honest. They are upfront.  Thanks!

24/7 my arse, locked doors no answer, they’re not even open anymore but no sign or notice, just abandon you in an emergency. The voice mailbox is full and no one answers the phone! DO NOT GO TO THIS LOCATION

I was so glad I had Westbury on speed dial in case of emergency. Sadly, I did have to use it. Sadly as in, my sweet fur baby was ill. But the staff, all of them from the front desk to the vets to the vet techs, were phenominal. Communication was great, very clear with cost and expectation, very careful with treatment but also didn't keep her too long just in case. 2 nights of having my girl away was enough but she came home in such great shape. I am so thankful to the team at Westbury and they are for sure my go to in case of emergency.
Well run institution, between phone team, pharmacy, techs, and the vets. Have liked all the vets we have met so far (Drs Geistert and Watkins)
My dogs don't like the vet but they are given very good care here. I like that they are open 24/7.

I love this place. My dog was on her death bed and every other place I went to wasn’t cost effective. From the service, the price, the smiles, to how comfortable my dog was this spot is the best!! I’d give them 10 stars if I could.

I've had to rush my senior dog to this 24-hour vet clinic several times over the last couple of years due to incidents outside his primary vet’s regular business hours as he ages. Twice for injuries after grappling with stray cats during a walk (he earned himself a nice cat scratch down the middle of his eyeball once, which was a fun recovery… lol). Another time, he appeared to have hurt his leg after landing on a box wrong (it turned out he was just a drama- king). And most recently, a visit after he lost his ability to stand or hold his bladder over several hours late one Sunday evening. Each experience was exceptional.

I've never been seen by the same vet, likely because we only go for emergencies, and the quality of care has remained consistent. They are on top of getting you seen as soon as possible, and each staff member is knowledgeable, patient, and understanding. I've left feeling taken care of every time. The facility itself is also clean and comfortable.

If you have a vet emergency, I highly recommend this clinic!

UPDATE: Unfortunately, we lost my senior dog Leo in September of 2024. I’ve waited a year to update this review because I was THAT heartbroken. He had been through all of my 20’s, early 30’s, first child with me. So, it was rough. What I’d like to say, though, is that the team at this clinic whom were on staff that fateful night were impeccable. I CANNOT recommend this clinic more. They handled the emergency and heartbreaking outcome with the upmost care, patience, and respect. We got his ashes cremated and the vendor they use made the most lovely engraved box for him, truly didn’t expect but it made all the difference. Will always bring my animals here for emergency care. Attaching a picture of Leo for memorialization. ❤️ RIP Leo
Love Dr Jackson.  She's great

I brought my dog in for an emergency visit when our regular vet was closed. The staff (reception, the vet tech, and the veterinarian) were all very kind and caring. They were able to treat my dog promptly and effectively. In part because they avoided unnecessary tests or procedures, the final bill was very reasonable, IMO. Will definitely be recommending them for emergency visits!
Very professional 👏 in hard time …

Update:
That "one person" remained incapable of making or returning a phone call for over a year, and the issue was never resolved through them.  But shout out to Katia for making moves happen, getting the business paid and excelling where others failed.

I’m leaving this review in hopes that someone from Westbury Animal Hospital will finally see it and help me pay my bill.

I tried to pay before leaving with my cat but was told only one person could process it and to call the next day. I spent weeks trying to reach them with no success. Eventually, the bill was sent to collections—even though the delay was entirely on their end. I was told again that only one person could remove the late fee (which even their front desk agreed I shouldn’t owe), but that person remains unreachable.

Also: I was overcharged initially, they sent the wrong lab work to my regular vet (causing panic), and I was sent home with no aftercare plan or prescription for food, despite my cat being in serious condition.

The vets saved my cat, and I’m thankful for that—but the follow-up has been disorganized, stressful, and completely avoidable.
Quick, friendly, and much cheaper than I expected for a minor emergency visit! Thank you!

Friendly and informative staff. Took my senior 11 yr chihuahua for a severe ear infection. I come here once a few years 250 deposit for non established patients but covered ear exam, ear wash, ear medication and pain medication
Thank you.
Professional staff is always on hand. The doctors clearly know their stuff, and recommend appropriate treatments for issues that may arise

Had a dog emergency and the staff was very efficient and so kind to us, as we ended up having to put our beloved Angel down.  They were great throughout the whole process.  Would highly recommend this place for anyone needing pet care of any kind! They are Angels here!
We really liked this place and it was a late night emergency that brought it to our attention.  Their emergency clinic was able to address our pups needs and very caring staff!   We will be back
Nice but Pricey try Safe Haven

The veterinarians and staff are amazing! I love that they care about my pets just as much as I do.  I've recommended this practice to others, and every one of those people has been delighted by their care and service. Highly recommend!

This place was full of friendly people. I felt very welcomed.  Saw Dr. Watkins and she was perfect. Her bedside manner was on point, the appointment went so smoothly and informative.  I would highly recommend this facility.
They are the best!  The Doctor and staff showed a lot of patience with my jittery elderly dog, and got him on the mend.  I can’t say enough good things about Westbury Animal Hospital.

We lost Jake tonight. In the midst of the pain and grief of losing a beloved member of our family, Westbury Animal Hospital was very helpful in accommodating us. Carlos, the vet tech (I assume), went above and beyond in making sure our last moments with Jake was sweet and tender. We can’t thank you enough Carlos, for your comforting presence.  You gave me, my wife and son, the space to say our goodbyes and give Jake the sendoff he deserved.

Amazing place.  I fostered a kitten named Simba. They gave my everything I needed to keep him healthy and get him back to his normal. It’s been 3 days since I brought him here and he is doing amazing 💜 there prices are very fair !!! I actually want to make the drive & bring all my pets here !!! …

Woke up early sunday morning to find my 12 week old puppy lethargic surrounded by vomit. Searched the nearest urgent care/animal hospital and found Westbury animal hospital open 24 hrs.  I called for about 20 min with no answer so I stopped wasting time and just drove there as it was only 12 mins from my house. I arrived at 7 am to find the doors locked and called again being as I could see an employee walking around. Finally the front desk answered as I could see her through the window answer my call.. she informed me that they are open but that the morning Dr. Would not be in until 9 am but I am more than welcome to come in and wait for him to come in,  which defeats the purpose of an urgent care facility if there is no sense of urgency.

I’d like to praise and thank Dr. Geistert and her staff for the help and compassion they provided me in my most painful moments. Last week I had to make the hardest and most unexpected decision of my life. My beautiful best friend of 7 years started having breathing issues the night before. Thinking it was related to his asthma flaring up, I took him to Westbury not knowing it would be the last day I got to spend with him.    Dr. Geistert told me they would put him in the Oxygen tank and give him steroid shots to help the breathing. She also told me the heavy breathing is probably due to his asthma, but it could also be congenital heart disease and if that was the case the steroid shots could make it worse. Never having been diagnosed with heart issues in the past, we agreed to move forward. 2 hours later I received a call with the worse news, he had reacted badly to the shots and his little heart was failing. They allowed me to sit in the back with him for literally hours as he struggled to breathe, but at least he wasn’t alone. The staff was nothing but supportive and Dr. Geistert met with me multiple times throughout the course of her busy schedule that day to talk to me about my options very compassionately. I was sobbing uncontrollably, and they understood. They never pressured me to make a decision and always gave me options but kept the prognostics real. The whole time they allowed me to stay with him in the back and I’ll forever be grateful for that. After hours of watching him struggle to breathe, I made the decision but asked if we could do it outside in the sunlight as that was always his favorite place. They accommodated that too and I’m very thankful he saw the outside and felt the sunlight one last time. They made my hardest day a little easier and I could not imagine going through that at a place where I’d be pressured to make a decision because of the time, questions, or space I was taking up, or the scene I was making. They were understanding every step of the way.
Fantastic zoo, great volunteer staff!

Review

I brought my Belgian Malinois in early yesterday evening as she had been having a poor appetite and diarrhea.  Check in was easy enough but my experience with was off-putting.

My dog is normal friendly and well behaved but did bark at the vet. Im assuming it’s because she didn’t feel well. I did mention I was more than fine with them putting a muzzle on her, anxiety meds etc. The vet proceeds to say that it may be best for me to bring a sample in tomorrow.  Now, the reason I’m paying a premium to be seen after hours is because I want to figure out what’s going on as soon as possible. It’s also hard for me to just miss work as I have patients with appointments that I can’t cancel on last minute. So, I went outside and walked up and down the street until we got a sample. Mind you, no temperature was taken. I feel like this is an essential step.  It seems as though they just assumed my dog was aggressive and didn’t want to deal with her. I know they don’t know that but there are steps that can be taken to get her the care she needs.

Things took a turn for the worse last night and she’s currently with her regular vet getting more tests. They are waiting on the fecal results and we have nothing yet. I called to find out and was met with “oh I’m not sure how long it will take, depends on where it is in line”.  I’m surprised there is no in house lab as this is a very large animal hospital.

That being said, the vet was very dismissive and seemed like she didn’t want to help. We have yet to get results on the fecal sample I had to collect myself.  Urgent care with urgent care fees but zero urgency. I really did have high hopes as I have heard nothing but good things about Westbury. I’m disappointed at having lost time and money.

I took our new cat to Westbury Animal Hospital after he got sick and I saw a strand of nylon from his worm toy in it. Since I didn't know how much he'd ingested, I took him in. It was a long wait, but since he was acting normally we didn't mind waiting for them to take care of more critical animals. The performed an x-ray and, when it wasn't perfectly clear, asked us to go home, fast, and bring him back the next day. I was very pleased with the way they handled our case, as I wanted to be 100% confident that he was clear. Hopefully I never need urgently care for a cat again, but if I do, at least now I know where to go.

I brought my baby in October 2023.    For urgent care.  She was in anaphylactic shock. Is what they told me.     She also has a small lump on her left ear that was open and bleeding.    I ask the doctor. To also look at her ear   She responded with. Let’s see what’s going on first.   Like it wasn’t a big deal.  So I let it go thinkin it was nothing.   Well now it has grown bigger and busted again.  I took her to her doc.   They tell me she has mass cell tumor    And it has gotten to her lymph nodes node in neck.  So I believe if the doc would have simply looked at her ear. It would not be full blown cancer now.   I wrote them.   I’m hoping they will do the right thing.  Please pray for my baby thank you.

Always do a great job with my pet. Aggresive tiny Chihuahua and they were able to get his shots in and clip his nails with ZERO issues. They also helped my blind Husky who was attacked by vicious dogs and saved her life along with following up to remediate a possible infection to the wounds. The staff loves being there and always treats us with respect. If you were treated otherwise maybe you should look inwards towards your tone with people and dont look to receive free services anywhere. They were decently priced but any money paid towards a happy and healthy pet is worth their weight in gold.
Love Dr. Cooper.
This vet is always helpful and efficient.
I've been taking my dogs there for years. Very compassionate team.

No hassles or expensive initial exam and onboarding fees...they handled my dogs injury quickly and for a very reasonable cost.

Westbury has become my new clinic for all of my dogs needs in the future...thank you!
Salem is still sweet lovable cuddling cat. Dr Chalkley and the staff are the best in Houston!

This place is a complete joke!!! My 4 year old service dog was ill and being it was at night on a Saturday we had to drive almost 2 hours for a 24 hour vet. We tried calling several times but their after hours line is a load of crap and nobody answers. Needless to say, my baby needs immediate care so we rush out there, arrive about 9:30pm or so,  get inside and the front desk lady cuts me off and says their only 24 hours for established patients. I will say wasn’t very polite when I commented that had they answered their phones, we could have avoided all that and just taken him for care and because her response of “if been sitting here all night and the phone never rang” I was not happy. There was body sitting in there when we pulled up, both my husband and myself called while we were sitting in the truck again and she was not sitting there and again no answer. She then told us to take him to Sunset which turned out to be even worse than this place. Don’t waste your time if you have an emergency safety hours and you’re not already a patient.
I cannot recommend Dr. Watkins highly enough, she is one of a kind
The ONLY place I will ever take my pet. Dr. Cooper is the best!!

Great animal hospital and clinic, great number of vets available and other related pet services to satisfy most pet needs. Our family has many pets and in a moment of medical needs we take them to Westbury.
They really care about animals here.
Awesome place!!!
Pleasant and helpful.  Listening to  all of the input about my cat's symptoms, and physical conditions.

Our cat was in intensive care for 1.5 days. When we checked her out the carrier (soft cloth cat carrier) was missing the bottom piece as well as the blanket she had. I've been to the clinic in person 3 times to recover the missing items without any result. Now hear that 'the clinic is not responsible for any lost items'.  Sorry, come again?? You loose the stuff and the customer has to pay for YOUR mistake??
This is not the only reason to give a zero star rating. While our pet was there for fluids etc to make her eat again, she was put on a cone that prevented her physically to reach her food. That was so called because the cat is aggressive, which she is not. If you are being pocket around with needles etc... of course many animals will defend themselves or show they are scared. For an animal clinic not to be able to handle this properly is beyond me as well. Super disappointed how they are handling the lost items and we frowned seriously on the situation with the cone preventing our pet to eat while in their care.
Stefan Ceulemans
